items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think an Art Neville and James Black. [INTERVIEWEE] ... James Rivers and I went to Booker T together.

ctx.x: I liked all records, all the records that are out here. And I liked Ranky Tank type pianos. I liked Fats Waller. I liked Professor Longhair, of course. Ray Charles. Lloyd Glenn. Albert Hammond. By Albert Hammond. Fuck like that.
Did you go to, I think it was a green high school with James Rivers? I think you were like a year or two ahead of him. I think an Art Neville and James Black.

Not green school, I don't think. I registered for a green school one year. I think it was when it was, well, I don't know what was going on during that period, but it was some sort of transitional period going on. And I registered, but I didn't go to that school green. So I didn't get that. James Rivers and I went to Booker T together.
